study type: Prospective single-blinded parallel multi-center randomized controlled trial
exposure: transverse extension of the uterine incision
longitudinal extension of the uterine incision
cohort: Women with a uterine scar from a previous cesarean delivery
finding: Longitudinal blunt extension of the uterine incision during cesarean section in women with a previous scar resulted in less hemoglobin drop and fewer additional stitches compared to transverse extension, with no difference in unintended uterine extension.
mod_finding: This study examined different techniques for extending the lower segment transverse uterine incision during cesarean delivery in women with a uterine scar from a previous cesarean delivery.
